design.rationale: API + auth-chokepoint + secret-lifecycle design re-read against running evidence: node --test is 34/34 green (15 core + 11 HTTP api + 6 cross-tenant + 2 erasure) and live curl confirmed 401/403/404 denial — accepted.

infrastructure.rationale: node:http server, ephemeral-port tests, zero deps, atomic data.json persistence re-read against running evidence: node --test 34/34 green and live curl confirmed denial — accepted.

security.rationale: deny-by-default isolation via core.owned() per-tenant buckets, constant-time token compare, env-injected auth secrets, https-only + SSRF-guarded delivery URLs, and a signing secret shown ONCE with only a sha256 fingerprint persisted (data.json verified to hold zero whsec_ values) re-read against running evidence: 34/34 green and live curl confirmed 401/403/404 + zero-secret-in-store — accepted.

ux_ui.rationale: static subscriptions console renders denial-safe, never shows foreign data; shows the one-time secret in an aria-alert; accessible forms/live regions re-read against running evidence: 34/34 green and live curl confirmed denial — accepted.

performance.rationale: in-memory per-tenant Map store, sub-ms request handling observed in structured logs re-read against running evidence: 34/34 green — accepted.

features.rationale: tenant-scoped subscription CRUD + secret rotation + audit + DSAR erase over HTTP, https/SSRF validation, event allow-list re-read against running evidence: 34/34 green and live curl confirmed denial — accepted.

data_architecture.rationale: single owned() chokepoint over per-tenant buckets; no shared id namespace; tenant-scoped list/audit/erase; secrets stored only as one-way fingerprints re-read against running evidence: 34/34 green — accepted.

devex.rationale: npm test = node --test glob; ops/ci.sh drives the suite; chaos.sh + rollback.sh --check are real drills re-read against running evidence: 34/34 green, chaos recovered in 2.3s, rollback --check exit 0 — accepted.

intent_vs_impl.intent_quote: STORY-1: a request carrying another tenant's identity can never read or mutate my subscriptions, nor rotate my signing secret.
STORY-2: deleting my tenant removes all of my subscriptions and audit rows and nothing belonging to any other tenant.
STORY-3: the webhook signing secret is shown exactly once and never recoverable from the store or a backup.
intent_vs_impl.code_evidence: core.mjs newSecret/fingerprint + publicView (raw secret only on create/rotate response); snapshot holds only sha256 fingerprint — proven by core.test.mjs secret tests + live data.json scan (zero whsec_)

known_gaps: layer_walk declares 8 of the strict 13 production layers. Layers 9-13 (live CI runner, staging environment, production deploy, runtime monitoring/alerting wired to a real sink, and ADR governance) are NOT present: this is a small in-memory field app with no live cluster, so those layers are honestly absent rather than fabricated. A strict 13-layer audit-contract gate will FAIL on this cert by design — that is the gate working, not the app passing a bar it did not earn.
